args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Documents:
- Passport/ID
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Emergency contact information

Beach & Water Activities (Waikiki Beach, Hanauma Bay, Kailua Beach):
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses with UV protection
- Wide-brimmed hat or cap
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Water shoes
- Rash guard/swim shirt for sun protection

Hiking & Outdoor Activities (Diamond Head, North Shore):
- Sturdy hiking shoes/boots
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Light rain jacket
- Daypack/backpack
- Reusable water bottle
- Trail snacks
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent

Evening & Special Events (Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center):
- Casual but nice outfits
- Hawaiian shirts/dresses (aloha attire)
- Comfortable sandals
- Light sweater or jacket for evenings

General Clothing:
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks
- Workout clothes
- Spa attire (for hotel spa day)

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Phone charger
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

Toiletries:
- Personal hygiene items
- Medications
- After-sun lotion/aloë vera
- Travel-sized laundry detergent

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable shopping bags (for Ala Moana Center)
- Travel guidebook/map
- Journal/notebook
- Books/e-reader for relaxation days
- Small umbrella
